title: Step 4 - recall: the Bookmark type from memory
intro: There is no ghost text and nothing turns red.
It needs a `Bookmark` struct with fields `ID` (int),
tagged so JSON calls them `id`, `url`, `title` and
`created`, and leaves `title` out when it is empty.
Press `<F6>` to submit: `go vet` and the step's hidden
tests decide. If they fail, fix it and submit again.
